name: Accepting a seeded finding and turning it into an eval case surfaces the case on the agent's Evals tab
description: From PR #482's findings, accept the seeded CRITICAL finding (seed ships it untriaged — AC-4 keeps 'Turn into eval case' disabled until an Accept/Dismiss decision exists), click 'Turn into eval case' (AC-1/AC-2, pre-seeds must_find from the finding's file/line/severity/category/title), save, then open the owning agent's Evals tab and wait for the new case's name (the finding's title, per FindingsPanel's buildEvalSeed). Read-only except for the Accept + eval-case-create mutations — no model call. Assumes the freshly-seeded hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
